AWPTCM-T33236.objective:
• A port configured for fixed full duplex establishes a link with a compliant partner at the configured speed.
  • A port configured for fixed half duplex establishes a link with a compliant partner at the configured speed.
  • Changing the duplex configuration (half or full) on an ETH or switchport does not cause the port LED to turn off while the link remains up.
  • The port accurately reports the configured duplex mode (full or half, not Auto) together with speed in interface status and show commands.
  • Fixed duplex settings are retained after port flaps, reloads, and supported pluggable insert/remove operations.
  • Duplex mismatch between link partners results in link failure or errors that are correctly reported by the port.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
Configure a port for fixed full duplex at a supported speed (e.g. 1000/Full). Confirm the link comes up, the port reports the fixed duplex (not Auto), LED remains on, and traffic forwards correctly.
Configure the same port for fixed half duplex at a supported speed. Confirm link establishment, correct reporting of half duplex, LED state unchanged, and forwarding works.
While link is up, toggle between half and full duplex. Verify the port LED does not turn off during the change and link state updates correctly.
Verify show interface and related status commands accurately reflect the configured duplex mode, speed, and current link state in both half and full duplex.
Test retention of fixed duplex config across port shutdown/no-shutdown, reload scenarios, and pluggable hot-swap where applicable.
Force a duplex mismatch with the link partner. Confirm link does not come up or reports errors, and status reflects the misconfiguration.
